sections.title: Mansion Looks
sections.blurb: Give your Mansion a brand new look. It still makes the same Gold.

items.name: Mushroom Cottage
items.blurb: Grown, not built. The big cap keeps the ash off like a roof keeps off rain.

items.name: Old Windmill
items.blurb: It ground flour before the fire. The sails still turn in the wind.

items.name: Great Tree House
items.blurb: One tree survived the fire. Someone built a house in it.

items.name: Igloo
items.blurb: Cut from Borealis ice and carried south. It still has not melted.

sections.title: Decorations
sections.blurb: Placed on a free tile when you buy it. Just for fun — nothing merges with it. The big ones at the end can be seen from across the island.

items.name: Ash Pot
items.blurb: The island turned to ash. Keeping a little of it helps us remember.

items.name: Watch Bell
items.blurb: Keepers rang this bell to call the dragons home.

items.name: Mossy Step
items.blurb: Moss growing through a cracked step, with gold in the crack.

items.name: Chain Anchor
items.blurb: One hook, one chain, one island held up. There are thousands of them.

items.name: Ice Lantern
items.blurb: A flame kept inside ice. Someone up north knows how to do this.

items.name: Frozen Waterfall
items.blurb: A waterfall that froze in the middle of falling.

items.name: Rune Stone
items.blurb: Glowing lines under the snow. Nobody lit them, but they still glow.

items.name: Stone Pile
items.blurb: Stones, a green glass ball and a ribbon of light. A way of saying hello.

items.name: The First Keeper
items.blurb: A statue of the very first Keeper. The little dragon at her feet is a mystery.

items.name: The Broken Gate
items.blurb: Everyone who ever came home walked through this gate. It has been open since the fire.

items.name: The Ember Beacon
items.blurb: Lit every evening for four hundred years. Nobody remembers what answered it.

items.name: The Elder's Rest
items.blurb: A very old dragon fell asleep here long ago. The moss covered her gently.

items.name: The Tied Island
items.blurb: A little island the Keepers caught with chains before it floated away. One tree came with it.

sections.title: Dragon Looks
sections.blurb: You cannot buy a dragon — but your own dragons can wear a new look. Same eggs, same food, same friends.

items.name: Frost
items.blurb: From the ice of Borealis, with the northern lights shining through its wings.

items.name: Storm
items.blurb: It does not hide from thunder. It flies up and roars back.

items.name: Moonwhisker
items.blurb: Ribbons and starlight, and far too shy to land near you.

items.name: Ashglass
items.blurb: It spent a night in the volcano. Its scales turned to black glass, and the fire never went out.

items.name: Porcelain
items.blurb: Shiny like a painted vase, with gold where it once cracked.
